summary: Between June 19 and 23, 2026 the City of Dortmund sent 85 notices in towing/administrative-offence proceedings in which address and case data were mismatched, so recipients received details of another person's case. Citizens reported the discrepancies; the city attributed it to a complex technical error in the process, apologized on June 25, 2026, reported it to the NRW data protection authority and issued corrected notices.
